items.title: Inkling 2 Mini quantized locally
items.oneliner: Apple Silicon quantization repo runs Inkling 2 Mini in 5.4 GB, making local reasoning and coding tests practical.

items.title: Build PostgreSQL extensions in Go
items.oneliner: Experimental TinyGo toolkit turns annotated Go functions into PostgreSQL extensions, triggers, and custom index methods.

items.title: Compile C# without a runtime
items.oneliner: Native C# toolchain removes the .NET runtime and GC, producing small binaries for Linux, macOS, Windows, WASM, and DOS.

items.title: Live sync for Jujutsu repos
items.oneliner: Jujutsu sync tool mirrors local repos across machines without temp commits, branch pushes, or extra infrastructure.

items.title: Benchmark humans against current LLMs
items.oneliner: SimpleBench shows humans at 83.7% beating top models at 81.9% on basic reasoning tasks developers actually care about.

items.title: Valkey sorted sets use B+ trees
items.oneliner: Valkey's fbtree design cuts sorted set memory overhead by up to 43% while improving throughput over skiplists.

items.title: Verify Raft implementations formally
items.oneliner: Deep walkthrough of model checking etcd and HashiCorp Raft, including bugs found while proving real safety properties.

items.title: Use probabilistic structures in Go
items.oneliner: Hands-on Go guide compares Bloom and binary fuse filters, with memory and false-positive tradeoffs you can apply immediately.

items.title: Adopt deterministic simulation testing
items.oneliner: Practical testing essay explains how deterministic simulation catches concurrency and state bugs outside distributed systems too.

items.title: Run a terminal cell aquarium
items.oneliner: Cloneable ASCII simulation renders immune cells, bacteria, mitosis, and viral replication directly in your terminal.
